summary: Independent review of Jinshu 109 units s0039-s0057 (Murong Huang, AD 335-337), covering all 80 owned items and 27 owned people. The 咸康三年 kingship, amnesty and appointments are correctly AD 337 (Jin Emperor Cheng, Xiankang 3). The pre-kingship campaigns keep the uncertainty window AD 335-337, from the 咸康初 anchor to the dated kingship, without false precision. Zizhi tongjian, checked as an external primary witness, places these episodes in 336-337. Murong Ren's execution (claim-348, AD 336) is now supported by Tongjian's dating to the 1st month of Xiankang 2. The hints for Duan Liao, Duan Lan and Murong Jun now include their dated context activity. No omitted births, deaths or ages were found, and no findings remain. English: only the supplied en field was read, and no definite defect was found in the owned units; any other literal field was not supplied and is unchecked. This is not a full-chapter or publication approval.

references.title: 資治通鑑 卷095 晉紀十七 (Wikisource)
references.quote: 鹹康二年（丙申，公元三三六年）
references.reason: Year heading for the section that narrates Huang's ice crossing and Ren's death (賜仁死) in the 1st month of Xiankang 2. Month 1 begins after late January, so it lies in AD 336 under both Julian and proleptic Gregorian reckoning.

references.title: 資治通鑑 卷095 晉紀十七 (Wikisource)
references.quote: 夏，六月，段遼遣中軍將軍李詠襲慕容皝
references.reason: Places the Li Yong raid, the Duan Lan/Yuwen threat and the Feng Yi ambush in AD 336, inside the claimed 335-337 window.

references.title: 資治通鑑 卷095 晉紀十七 (Wikisource)
references.quote: 三月，慕容皝於乙連城東築好城以逼乙連
references.reason: Places Haocheng, Lan Bo's grain seizure and Qu Yun's defeat in Xiankang 3 (AD 337) before the kingship, inside the 335-337 window.

references.title: 資治通鑑 卷095 晉紀十七 (Wikisource)
references.quote: 冬，十月，丁卯，皝即燕王位，大赦
references.reason: Confirms the accession, amnesty and appointments in Xiankang 3 (AD 337).

references.title: 資治通鑑 卷096 晉紀十八 (Wikisource)
references.quote: 十二月，段遼自密雲山遣使求迎於趙
references.reason: Under Xiankang 4. The 12th month spans the AD 338/339 boundary, which supports the 339 endpoint of Duan Liao's context window and hint rather than a precise year.

references.quote: 仁不虞皝之至也，軍去平郭七里，候騎乃告，仁狼狽出戰，為皝所擒，殺仁而還。
references.reason: Jinshu narration of Ren's capture and execution, which has no internal year; it is dated via Tongjian.

references.quote: 封弈等以皝任重位輕，宜稱燕王，皝於是以咸康三年僭即王位，赦其境內。
references.reason: The explicit 咸康三年 anchor that bounds every pre-kingship window and dates the kingship claims.

references.quote: 以封弈為國相，韓壽為司馬，裴開、陽騖、王寓、李洪、杜群、宋該、劉瞻、石琮、皇甫真、陽協、宋晃、平熙、張泓等並為列卿將帥。
references.reason: The appointment list dated by its continuation of the s0056 kingship act.
